name: Build NetShare APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      BUILD_DIR: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
      RN_VERSION: '0.74.1'

    steps:

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-netshare-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Initialize React Native project
        run: |
          cd /home/runner
          npx --yes react-native@${{ env.RN_VERSION }} init NetShareBuild \
            --version ${{ env.RN_VERSION }} \
            --skip-install
        env:
          CI: false

      - name: Copy JS source files
        run: |
          rm -f "$BUILD_DIR/App.tsx"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/App.jsx"                    "$BUILD_DIR/App.jsx"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/index.js"                   "$BUILD_DIR/index.js"
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services" "$BUILD_DIR/src/store"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx" "$BUILD_DIR/src/screens/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/services/VpnService.js" "$BUILD_DIR/src/services/"
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src/store/index.js"         "$BUILD_DIR/src/store/"
          echo "=== JS files copied ==="

      - name: Merge package.json (with compatible dependency pins)
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import json, os
          wp = os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]
          bd = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"]
          repo     = json.load(open(wp + "/package.json"))
          scaffold = json.load(open(bd + "/package.json"))
          # Only merge deps — do NOT copy react/react-native from repo
          # as the scaffold already has the correct versions
          repo_deps = repo.get("dependencies", {})
          repo_deps.pop("react", None)
          repo_deps.pop("react-native", None)
          scaffold["dependencies"].update(repo_deps)
          scaffold["devDependencies"].update(repo.get("devDependencies", {}))
          # Pin reanimated to last version supporting RN 0.74
          scaffold["dependencies"]["react-native-reanimated"] = "3.6.1"
          scaffold["dependencies"]["react-native-gesture-handler"] = "^2.14.1"
          json.dump(scaffold, open(bd + "/package.json", "w"), indent=2)
          print("Merged package.json — reanimated pinned to 3.6.1, react/react-native kept from scaffold")
          PYEOF

      - name: Copy AndroidManifest
        run: |
          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml" \
             "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
          echo "=== AndroidManifest copied ==="

      - name: Copy native Java source files
        run: |
          JAVA_DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/java/com/netsharebuild"
          mkdir -p "$JAVA_DEST"
          for FILE in VpnModule.java VpnPackage.java NetShareVpnService.java; do
            SRC="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare/$FILE"
            sed 's/^package com\.netshare;/package com.netsharebuild;/' "$SRC" > "$JAVA_DEST/$FILE"
            sed -i 's/com\.netshare\./com.netsharebuild./g' "$JAVA_DEST/$FILE"
            echo "Copied: $FILE"
          done
          ls -la "$JAVA_DEST/"

      - name: Patch MainApplication.kt to register VpnPackage
        run: |
          FILE=$(find "$BUILD_DIR/android" -name "MainApplication.kt" | head -1)
          echo "=== Patching: $FILE ==="
          if ! grep -q "VpnPackage" "$FILE"; then
            python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import re, os, glob

          # Find MainApplication.kt
          build_dir = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"]
          matches = glob.glob(build_dir + "/android/**/MainApplication.kt", recursive=True)
          if not matches:
              print("ERROR: MainApplication.kt not found!")
              exit(1)
          f = matches[0]
          print("Found: " + f)
          content = open(f).read()

          # 1. Add import after ReactApplication import
          if "import com.netsharebuild.VpnPackage" not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(import com\.facebook\.react\.ReactApplication)',
                  'import com.netsharebuild.VpnPackage\n\\1',
                  content
              )

          # 2. RN 0.74 scaffold uses PackageList(this).packages.apply { ... }
          #    Inject add(VpnPackage()) inside that block
          if "VpnPackage()" not in content:
              # Pattern A: apply block style (RN 0.74 default)
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(PackageList\(this\)\.packages\.apply\s*\{)',
                  r'\1\n              add(VpnPackage())',
                  content
              )

          # Pattern B: fallback — getPackages() returning mutableListOf
          if "VpnPackage()" not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(return\s+mutableListOf\s*\()',
                  r'return mutableListOf(\n              VpnPackage(),',
                  content
              )

          open(f, "w").write(content)
          print("VpnPackage successfully registered")
          PYEOF
          else
            echo "VpnPackage already present, skipping"
          fi
          echo "=== Verification ==="
          grep -n "VpnPackage\|PackageList\|getPackages" "$FILE" || true

      - name: Patch app build.gradle
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import re, os
          p = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/app/build.gradle"
          content = open(p).read()

          # Fix applicationId
          content = re.sub(r'applicationId\s+"[^"]+"', 'applicationId "com.netsharebuild"', content)

          # FIX: AGP 8.2.1 (locked by RN 0.74's gradle plugin — cannot be overridden via
          # classpath because RN 0.74 uses pluginManagement with no version in classpath string).
          # androidx.core:core:1.16.0 requires AGP >= 8.6.0 but we can't upgrade AGP easily.
          # SOLUTION: Force androidx.core and androidx.core-ktx down to 1.15.0, the last
          # version compatible with AGP 8.2.1. This is done via resolutionStrategy.force
          # which overrides any transitive dependency that tries to pull in 1.16.0.
          # FIX: bump compileSdk to 35 so androidx.core:1.15.0+ AAR metadata check passes
          # (androidx.core 1.15.0 requires compileSdk >= 35; AGP 8.2.1 supports compileSdk 35)
          content = re.sub(r'compileSdk\s*=?\s*\d+', 'compileSdk = 35', content)
          content = re.sub(r'compileSdkVersion\s*\d+', 'compileSdkVersion 35', content)

          # Add java-websocket dependency required by NetShareVpnService.java
          websocket_dep = "    implementation 'org.java-websocket:Java-WebSocket:1.5.4'"
          if 'java-websocket' not in content:
              content = re.sub(
                  r'(dependencies \{)',
                  r'\1\n' + websocket_dep,
                  content
              )

          open(p, "w").write(content)
          print("app/build.gradle patched")
          print("  applicationId = com.netsharebuild")
          print("  compileSdk bumped to 35")
          print("  java-websocket:1.5.4 added")
          PYEOF

      - name: Fix gradle.properties
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import os
          p = os.environ["BUILD_DIR"] + "/android/gradle.properties"
          lines = open(p).readlines()
          result, seen = [], set()
          for line in lines:
              key = line.split("=")[0].strip() if "=" in line else ""
              if key and key in seen:
                  continue
              if key:
                  seen.add(key)
              result.append(line)
          required = [
              "org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m\n",
              "android.useAndroidX=true\n",
              "android.enableJetifier=true\n",
              # Suppress the compileSdk 34 vs 35 warning that doesn't block build
              # but keep it clean in logs
              "android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=35\n",
          ]
          for req in required:
              key = req.split("=")[0].strip()
              if not any(key in line for line in result):
                  result.append(req)
          open(p, "w").writelines(result)
          print("gradle.properties fixed")
          PYEOF

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm install
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild

      - name: Copy vector icon fonts
        run: |
          FONTS_SRC="$BUILD_DIR/node_modules/react-native-vector-icons/Fonts"
          FONTS_DEST="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/fonts"
          mkdir -p "$FONTS_DEST"
          if [ -d "$FONTS_SRC" ]; then
            cp "$FONTS_SRC"/*.ttf "$FONTS_DEST/"
            echo "Fonts copied"
          else
            echo "No fonts dir, skipping"
          fi

      - name: Bundle JS into Android assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets"
          npx react-native bundle \
            --platform android \
            --dev false \
            --entry-file index.js \
            --bundle-output "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle" \
            --reset-cache
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          CI: false
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: |
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
        working-directory: /home/runner/NetShareBuild
        env:
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_HOME }}
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}

      - name: Verify APK
        run: |
          APK="$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
            echo "APK not found!"
            find "$BUILD_DIR/android/app/build" -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null || echo "No APK anywhere"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SUCCESS: $(du -h $APK)"

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: NetShare-debug-apk
          path: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.run_number }}
          name: NetShare v${{ github.run_number }}
          body: |
            ## NetShare APK - Build #${{ github.run_number }}
            1. Download **app-debug.apk** below
            2. Transfer to your Android phone
            3. Tap Install (enable Unknown sources if asked)
            4. Works standalone - no development server needed
          files: /home/runner/NetShareBuild/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
